{{Quote|Remember&mdash;peace is a lie.|Veshta, to a Sith Warrior|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Veshta''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Warrior]] who was part of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She helped guard one of the entrances to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ajunta Pall]]'s [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall|tomb]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|No Jedi will be able to stand against you.|Veshta, to a Sith acolyte|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Veshta was a [[Sith Warrior]] affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a period of unrest between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At one point she was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] guarding one of the entrances to the [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall|tomb]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ajunta Pall]] with a [[Sith Inquisitor]] named [[Gesen]], an [[Imperial soldier]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] named [[Cormun (Imperial Army)|Cormun]], and Cormun's [[Trooper/Legends|troops]]. She also provided training to [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]] learning to be [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Warriors at the nearby [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
While in the tomb, Veshta spoke with an [[Empire's Wrath|acolyte]], against whom she believed no [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] would be able to stand. She encouraged the acolyte's pursuit of power and reminded the individual of a portion of the [[Code of the Sith/Legends|Sith Code]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You desire more power? Good.|Veshta, speaking to an acolyte|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Veshta had [[Color/Legends|light brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and fair skin. She considered the pursuit of greater power a good goal and peace to be a lie&mdash;two views that were in accordance with the Sith Code.<ref name="TOR" />

==Equipment==
While in Ajunta Pall's tomb, Veshta wore red-and-gray [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and carried a red-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Veshta first appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. She is a trainer for Sith Warriors on the planet Korriban, and she has the same dialogue as other Sith Warrior trainers. The player is not required to speak with her.<ref name="TOR" /> Although her name is not mentioned, Veshta's location as a Sith Warrior trainer is identified on the maps of Korriban in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a book released at the same time as the game.<ref name="TOREG">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
